recipe: Super Video Maker: screencast-demo adapted for an in-engine game trailer

spine.viewer: Digimon fans who enjoy building teams and auto chess
spine.promise: Build a team, fight solo or in pairs, and care for Digimon between matches
spine.mechanism: Buy three matching copies to evolve, then position the team for automatic battles

angle: Follow Agumon from rookie to evolved fighter, then reveal the combined Double Up battlefield

design.captions: Short animated editorial labels, no full-width bars

shots.camera: Full UI into shop and bench detail; purchase cursor and click pulses
Match cut to the purchased evolution, close low-angle orbit
Normal solo combat with visible HUD
Continue the same fight from a tighter moving three-quarter camera
Show partner, team health and combined battlefield HUD
Sweep across the two allied teams, then pull back to show the larger battle
Real DigiFarm care: feed meat, then praise Tokomon; keep care controls and stat changes visible
Hold the corrected cover while the CTA rises and fades in

capture: Real models and combat in isolated staged local matches. Camera and HUD changes are capture-only. No fabricated gameplay, multiplayer session or public availability verification.
recipeAdaptations: Retain music-only game-trailer format, use actual 3D camera paths instead of a laptop mockup, and use existing deterministic capture to prevent dropped frames. No paid external generation required. Apply skill-local layout and FFmpeg QC.
